- Goals: saltbox wants an initial integration for automated patient messaging and secure PHI-handling inference by Q3; target go-live window ~first week of August.
- Success criteria we agreed on: 95% SLA availability for inference, PII redaction checks in pipeline, pass security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence item list.
- Risks identified: procurement timeline and internal IT whitelisting (firewall rules).

Attached is the first Mutual Action Plan (Saltbox_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx). I populated recommended milestones and owners based on today’s discussion — please review and highlight any changes.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You to confirm internal stakeholders and procurement point-of-contact (POC) by Thu 7/2.
2) Redirect any security evidence requests to Evelyn (cc’ing her on this thread).
3) We’ll produce MAP v2 with exact milestone dates and handoffs by Mon 7/6.

Can you confirm whether the target go-live window (week of 8/3) still aligns with your internal priorities?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with an updated draft next week.

Best,
